docs.title: LSL.HttpMessageHandlers.Capturing.Core
docs.text: Provides a message handler as the basis for capturing requests and responses.

docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
The following example uses the provided DelegatingAsyncRequestAndResponseCapturer (it assumes an IServiceCollection for services):

var capturedUrls = new List<string>();

services
    .AddHttpClient<MyTestClient>()
    .AddRequestAndResponseCapturing(c => c
        .AddCapturingHandlerFactory(serviceProvider => 
            new DelegatingAsyncRequestAndResponseCapturer(c =>
            {
                capturedUrls.Add(c.Request.RequestUri.ToString());
                return Task.CompletedTask;
            }))
    );

// when the client is used then all request URIs will be captured in capturedUrls

docs.title: The Capturing Context
docs.text: Any implementation of IAsyncRequestAndResponseCapturer will contain a single method called CaptureAsync that is given a CaptureContext instance that holds information about the request, response and any exception that may have been thrown.

docs.title: Request
docs.text: The Request property will always have the original HttpRequestMessage that was passed into the handler.

docs.title: Response
docs.text: The Response property will have an HttpResponseMessage if the HTTP call did not throw an exception.

docs.title: Exception
docs.text: The Exception property will have the exception that was thrown if the HTTP call failed.

docs.title: StopProcessing method
docs.text:
This method can be used to stop processing any more IAsyncRequestResponseCapturer instances that have been configured.

This can be useful in situations where you may want capturing to be disabled in certain scenarios.

docs.title: WithExceptionAndRequestAsync
docs.text:
This method can be used to execute an async handler to process an exception if one has been thrown by the http send operation.

await context.WithExceptionAndRequestAsync(async (exception, request) => 
{
    await DoSomethingAsyncWithTheExceptionAndRequest(exception, request);
})

docs.title: WithExceptionAndRequest
docs.text:
This method can be used to execute a sync handler to process an exception if one has been thrown by the http send operation.

context.WithExceptionAndRequest((exception, request) => 
{
    DoSomethingWithTheExceptionAndRequest(exception, request);
})

docs.title: WithRequestAndResponseAsync
docs.text:
This method can be used to execute an async handler to process a http request and response after a successful http send operation.

await context.WithRequestAndResponseAsync(async (request, response) => 
{
    await DoSomethingAsyncWithTheRequestAndResponse(request, response);
})

docs.title: WithRequestAndResponse
docs.text:
This method can be used to execute a sync handler to process a http request and response after a successful http send operation.

context.WithRequestAndResponse((request, response) => 
{
    DoSomethingWithTheRequestAndResponse(request, response);
})
